274360803.description:
Two Vintage Smoking Pipes Ornate Gold-Tone & Dark Wood Bent 5-6 Inch Used
This listing includes two vintage smoking pipes. The first pipe features an ornate design with gold-toned decorative metal bands around the bowl and stem, a brown wooden body, and an amber-colored mouthpiece. It has a maker's mark stamped on the side. The second pipe is made of dark wood with a black curved plastic or vulcanite mouthpiece and a classic bent shape. Both pipes measure approximately 5 to 6 inches in length. Both show signs of use, with visible wear and residue inside the bowls and stems.

Mixed Lot Collectible Rocks Minerals Stones Quartz Petrified Wood Arrowheads
This lot contains a diverse assortment of collectible rocks, minerals, and stones. Included are small polished river stones, rough mineral specimens, petrified wood pieces, quartz crystals, and possible arrowhead artifacts. The collection features various colors including gray, black, brown, white, and tan, with textures ranging from smooth and polished to rough and crystalline. Items are in mixed condition, from raw and uncut to tumbled and smooth. No brand or manufacturer markings are present. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or crafts.
